title: Scholarly Metascience & Research Integrity Benchmarks
subtitle: Empirical Metascience Benchmarks for Research Integrity
description: Official empirical companion benchmark suite for the monograph 'Jangkar & Kompas Riset Ilmiah' (18 Chapters, 40 KUM PO-PAK). Features multi-cluster empirical datasets: (1) Statcheck psychology reporting discrepancies (Nuijten 2016) and Ioannidis PPV parameters, (2) Causal concept inventory gains vs Cohen's d (Nissen 2018, 8,342 students), (3) Discrete integer data forensics (GRIM, GRIMMER, DEBIT, and Aiken exact polynomial convolution), and (4) Bibliometric knowledge topology disruption networks (Funk & Owen-Smith CD-Index, Uzzi Combinatorial Novelty).
